question: India's National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) were first notified under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 and were last revised in 2009.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually true. NAAQS were revised in 2009, adding PM2.5 limits; the earlier 1994 standards did not specify PM2.5 separately.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The 2009 revision introduced separate standards for PM2.5 for the first time in India, replacing the earlier 1994 standards.
